verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair thing to ask about. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy. The only machine-readable artifact is an llms.txt file, which is adjacent and not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
